rows.text: Winning the moment your customer decides at the shelf takes more than good products — it takes the right people, in the right store, at the right time. FLZR has solved that problem for brands across Europe for more than 20 years: staffing, training, live video advice and performance reporting, from one team.

We cover the full point-of-sale journey — training, promotion, live video consulting, merchandising, sales force, market entry and business intelligence — as one connected team instead of separate vendors. Brands like Intel, Microsoft, Telefónica and Sony already rely on this model; see how in our references.
"See how our team works →" / "Read the case studies →"

Retail campaigns fail as often from weak execution as from weak ideas. Since 2004, FLZR's 420-person team — 370 of them working at the point of sale every day — has closed that gap for brands entering or expanding across European retail.

We build campaigns around three things: people (a 24,000-strong personnel pool, matched to roles through AI-supported recruiting), data (in-house reporting for every campaign), and a 360° process from strategy to on-site execution. That's why departments from Account Management to Business Intelligence sit under one roof instead of being outsourced separately.
"Talk to the team →" / "See open roles →"

Untrained store staff cost brands sales every day — the wrong pitch, a missed cross-sell, no product confidence. FLZR closes that gap with practice-based sales training, product shows, live-streamed webinars and a certified e-learning platform — from a single in-store briefing to a Europe-wide rollout.

For LEDVANCE, we built a multilingual e-learning platform and knowledge base for the SMART+ launch, with personalised logins and progress tracking for dealers and staff across Europe — the same model behind every FLZR training program.
"See more training case studies →"

A promotion only pays off if it reaches the right shopper at the right moment — indoors, outdoors, online or in-store. FLZR plans and staffs contract, event and sales promotions, plus sampling campaigns, across Europe — backed by software-based analysis so you can see what's working while the campaign runs.

For Telefónica's o2 brand, we built a permanently employed sales team for Saturn and Media Markt stores, backed by a trainer team, a stand-in team for outages, and daily BI-based sales analysis — the model we apply to every long-term promotion contract.
"Talk to us about your next promotion →"

Online shoppers abandon high-consideration purchases when nobody can answer their questions. PoSLive puts a trained advisor on video at that exact moment — in your online store, or via kiosk/tablet in-store — so the sale doesn't stall.

For MediaSaturn, PoSLive runs permanent purchase advice across Germany, Austria and Spain with a 30-plus-strong consultant team, managed by a project team and shift leads, and backed by regular training — proof the model scales beyond a pilot.
"Try out live consulting on Saturn →" (kept)

Shelves that aren't maintained lose sales before a customer even picks up the product. FLZR's PoS management — visual merchandising, window dressing, showcase merchandising and rackjobbing — keeps shelves stocked, presentable and on-brand, with live reporting so you see the store, not just the sales number.

For Ubisoft, our merchandising team manages block and special placements, stock clearance and display expansion across hundreds of retail partners nationwide, on a fixed visit schedule — the same rackjobbing and merchandising model behind every PoS management contract.
"See our merchandising results →"

A sales force only pays for itself if it's the right size and structure for your brand — dedicated, shared, or a hybrid of both. FLZR offers Community Managers, Omnichannel Managers, a shared sales force for lower-volume brands, and a classic dedicated sales force, so you're not paying for capacity you don't need.

For Microsoft in the D-A-CH region, our omnichannel and community managers grew brand awareness and fanbase while keeping PoS readiness on target — with performance tracked and steered through regular business reviews.
"Talk to us about your sales force →"

Launching a product into European retail fails as often on partner selection and timing as on the product itself. FLZR plans market entry and expansion for consumer electronics and technology brands — from retail partnerships to in-store training — so your product arrives at the right retailers, positioned correctly, from day one.

[Evidence gap — do not invent a case] This page currently has no dedicated case study. We recommend adding one (e.g. a market-entry project) before publishing an updated version, since Go To Markets is otherwise the only core service without named proof on the site.
"Talk to us about market entry →"

Decisions made on last month's numbers are already too late for this week's shelf. FLZR's BI tools — myInventory, myMission, mySalesPro, Sales Forecasting, myImages and mySurveyAnalyzer — give you real-time visibility into stock, staffing, sales and store conditions, so you can act while the campaign is still running.
For Microsoft, weekly demand forecasting let us fine-tune inventory in near real time — reducing over- and understock and directly increasing sales, without extra headcount.
"See a sample dashboard →"

Every FLZR service on this site is backed by a named client, a defined result and a running or completed contract — not a claim. Below is a selection across consumer electronics, DIY, food, beauty and toys.
(Cases kept exactly as documented — no rewrite needed. This is already the strongest Digital Authority page on the site.)
"Ask about a similar project →"

Deciding on a first job in retail promotion is hard when every listing sounds the same. At FLZR that means: flat hierarchies, fast decisions, and a real say from day one — whether you become a brand ambassador, merchandiser, trainer, or start in our back office.
